question: GQ-001
subject: the last suite that was off the hook, now on it
the_carried_number: gates-are-load-bearing at 289s, carried as "too slow for the hook" for many turns
re_measured_first: 402s — it had gone UP, because the chain grew from 8 gates to 11 and this suite replays the chain once per gate

where_the_cost_actually_is.reading: two gates are 83% of the chain

a_probe_of_mine_that_measured_the_wrong_.what: timed removals with npm run verify and got 0-1s, concluding removals were free
a_probe_of_mine_that_measured_the_wrong_.why_wrong: npm run verify includes audit-verify-chain, which catches a missing gate immediately — but the SUITE excludes it from the chain it replays
a_probe_of_mine_that_measured_the_wrong_.corrected: baseline 59s, last gate removed 47s, first gate removed 0s — the chain short-circuits at whatever it removes

the_fix.what: moved the three cheap snapshot-independent gates to the front
the_fix.constraint_respected: build-observatory MUST precede audit-asserted-numbers, which re-derives the snapshot it writes

result: all FIVE suites now gate every push, 417s total — the last one carried as "off the hook" is on it
